description: timeline example, in the Vue adapter

files.content:
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { Timeline } from "@/components/audio-ui/timeline/vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Timeline.Root
    class="[--timeline-grid-color:color-mix(in_oklab,var(--border)_70%,transparent)] [--timeline-grid-accent-color:color-mix(in_oklab,var(--foreground)_16%,transparent)] flex w-full min-w-0 flex-col data-disabled:opacity-50"
    :duration="32"
    :snap-step="1"
  >
    <Timeline.Viewport
      class="bg-background relative min-h-0 min-w-0 overscroll-x-contain"
    >
      <Timeline.Ruler
        aria-label="Position"
        class="h-7 border-b bg-background text-muted-foreground text-xs has-focus-visible:bg-muted h-6 shrink-0 cursor-pointer touch-none select-none"
      />
      <Timeline.Lane class="h-14 border-b bg-muted/30 h-16">
        <Timeline.Playhead
          class="bg-primary pointer-events-none inset-y-0 w-px"
        />
        <Timeline.Clip
          aria-label="Kick"
          class="rounded-[min(var(--radius-sm),6px)] overflow-hidden bg-primary/25 ring-1 ring-primary/60 ring-inset data-[selected]:bg-primary/40 data-[selected]:ring-2 data-[selected]:ring-primary has-focus-visible:ring-2 has-focus-visible:ring-ring group/clip isolate inset-y-0 touch-none data-dragging:z-10 data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          clip="kick"
          :default-value="{ start: 2, length: 10, offset: 0, fadeIn: 0, fadeOut: 0 }"
        >
          <Timeline.ClipHeader
            class="bg-primary/30 data-[selected]:bg-primary/50 flex h-5 cursor-grab items-center truncate px-2 text-xs data-dragging:cursor-grabbing data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            clip="kick"
            >Kick</Timeline.ClipHeader
          >
          <Timeline.ClipHandle
            aria-label="Trim start of Kick"
            class="bg-primary/0 hover:bg-primary/60 has-focus-visible:bg-primary absolute inset-y-0 z-10 w-2 cursor-ew-resize data-[edge=end]:right-0 data-[edge=start]:left-0"
            clip="kick"
            edge="start"
          />
          <Timeline.ClipHandle
            aria-label="Trim end of Kick"
            class="bg-primary/0 hover:bg-primary/60 has-focus-visible:bg-primary absolute inset-y-0 z-10 w-2 cursor-ew-resize data-[edge=end]:right-0 data-[edge=start]:left-0"
            clip="kick"
            edge="end"
          />
        </Timeline.Clip>
        <Timeline.Clip
          aria-label="Fill"
          class="rounded-[min(var(--radius-sm),6px)] overflow-hidden bg-primary/25 ring-1 ring-primary/60 ring-inset data-[selected]:bg-primary/40 data-[selected]:ring-2 data-[selected]:ring-primary has-focus-visible:ring-2 has-focus-visible:ring-ring group/clip isolate inset-y-0 touch-none data-dragging:z-10 data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          clip="fill"
          :default-value="{ start: 14, length: 8, offset: 0, fadeIn: 0, fadeOut: 0 }"
        >
          <Timeline.ClipHeader
            class="bg-primary/30 data-[selected]:bg-primary/50 flex h-5 cursor-grab items-center truncate px-2 text-xs data-dragging:cursor-grabbing data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            clip="fill"
            >Fill</Timeline.ClipHeader
          >
          <Timeline.ClipHandle
            aria-label="Trim start of Fill"
            class="bg-primary/0 hover:bg-primary/60 has-focus-visible:bg-primary absolute inset-y-0 z-10 w-2 cursor-ew-resize data-[edge=end]:right-0 data-[edge=start]:left-0"
            clip="fill"
            edge="start"
          />
          <Timeline.ClipHandle
            aria-label="Trim end of Fill"
            class="bg-primary/0 hover:bg-primary/60 has-focus-visible:bg-primary absolute inset-y-0 z-10 w-2 cursor-ew-resize data-[edge=end]:right-0 data-[edge=start]:left-0"
            clip="fill"
            edge="end"
          />
        </Timeline.Clip>
      </Timeline.Lane>
      <Timeline.Lane class="h-14 border-b bg-muted/30 h-16">
        <Timeline.Playhead
          class="bg-primary pointer-events-none inset-y-0 w-px"
        />
        <Timeline.Clip
          aria-label="Bass"
          class="rounded-[min(var(--radius-sm),6px)] overflow-hidden bg-primary/25 ring-1 ring-primary/60 ring-inset data-[selected]:bg-primary/40 data-[selected]:ring-2 data-[selected]:ring-primary has-focus-visible:ring-2 has-focus-visible:ring-ring group/clip isolate inset-y-0 touch-none data-dragging:z-10 data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          clip="bass"
          :default-value="{ start: 6, length: 12, offset: 0, fadeIn: 0, fadeOut: 0 }"
        >
          <Timeline.ClipHeader
            class="bg-primary/30 data-[selected]:bg-primary/50 flex h-5 cursor-grab items-center truncate px-2 text-xs data-dragging:cursor-grabbing data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            clip="bass"
            >Bass</Timeline.ClipHeader
          >
          <Timeline.ClipHandle
            aria-label="Trim start of Bass"
            class="bg-primary/0 hover:bg-primary/60 has-focus-visible:bg-primary absolute inset-y-0 z-10 w-2 cursor-ew-resize data-[edge=end]:right-0 data-[edge=start]:left-0"
            clip="bass"
            edge="start"
          />
          <Timeline.ClipHandle
            aria-label="Trim end of Bass"
            class="bg-primary/0 hover:bg-primary/60 has-focus-visible:bg-primary absolute inset-y-0 z-10 w-2 cursor-ew-resize data-[edge=end]:right-0 data-[edge=start]:left-0"
            clip="bass"
            edge="end"
          />
        </Timeline.Clip>
      </Timeline.Lane>
    </Timeline.Viewport>
  </Timeline.Root>
</template>
